rate_units: percent (0..100), sample SD in percentage points

definitions.device_U: Sum of clipped raw layer compute intervals / (32 * 2000ms)
definitions.primary_SLO: Admissions in [2000,4000)ms; completion-admission <=1.5 * eight-layer pure C from corresponding frozen manifest; follow completion past4000ms.
definitions.TTFT_scope: Post-admission 8-layer processing proxy, not user arrival TTFT or real token/hardware timing. No decode/first-token event is measured.
definitions.arrival: All arrivals zero. Warm arrival cohort is empty/N/A. Arrival-origin SLO on warm-admission cohort is0%.
definitions.seed_weight: Arithmetic mean of each seed's rate; sample SD uses n-1. No pooling of unequal warm cohorts.
definitions.policy: Baseline vs shared-path once/Once per layer, collector5ms, identical staticCIR, no runtimeCIR writes, assignment fixed, no NPU migration or internal path reorder, modeled control costs0; no NewOnce.
definitions.capacity: Copied from the already audited full-run event scan; this integration independently recomputes U/SLO and verifies raw result/input/source hashes, not the event-scan capacity proof.
definitions.main_intervention: All studies already bind requests to fixed NPUs. Role-separated experiments change per-NPU population and its IO phases, not fixed versus dynamic dispatch.
